name: Tachikawa Maki
source:
[b]Workplace:[/b] Brand Pierrot
[b]Favorite brands:[/b] TSUMORI CHISATO, BEAMS
[b]Hobby:[/b] Watching late-night home shopping programs

A friend of Suzune who continues her part-time job while helping to restore Brand Pierrot, a shop that once went out of business. She is close with Suzune and also knows Kazumi. Because she is somewhat clumsy and lacks tact, she is often teased or tricked by Kazumi. While she has a complex about her small chest, she is confident in the rest of her appearance.
